title: Uranium +
description: This project adds uranium stuff to Minecraft
body:
Dependencies:
 - Mekanism (Required)
 - Mekanism: Generators (Recommended)

Mod made using MCreator

# What are the features?

## 1. Uratrans machine
It takes as input : power and an uranium ingot from mekanism
and outputs a new uranium ingot for my system.
## 2. Uraneater machine
It takes as input : power, bread and an uranium ingot (from my system)
and outputs a uranium bar that you can eat!
## 3. Automatisation Machine (ver>=1.1.0)
Machine to automate your uranium needs!
Usage in help UI.

## 3. Uranium Tools

S = Stick

## 5. Terrain Generation
Uranium Ore can generate in deepslate and normal caves, and is pretty common to find.
That's how you can get your first machine.

That's all, have fun!
